item.title: Trump plan to dismantle US weather research hub alarms scientists and state officials
item.description: A proposal by the Trump administration to break up the National Center for Atmospheric Research has sparked warnings from scientists, university leaders, and Colorado officials who say the move could undermine public safety, economic stability, and decades of shared scientific infrastructure.

item.title: The hidden crisis: How America fails to protect its children
item.description: From child labor to trafficking—and even foster care, sports, and detention—institutions meant to protect children often cause the greatest harm.

item.title: How MAGA changed the world in 2025, and what comes next
item.description: Amid the domestic and geopolitical mayhem unleashed by Donald Trump’s return to the White House, powerful interests were busy enacting a radical anti-democratic agenda.

item.title: Ending the American Dream by 2029?
item.description: The future seems to free the mind from reality’s restraints and let the imagination soar. Yet it has also proven full of political pitfalls.
